name: Virtuact XR
summary:
VIRTU-ACT is an innovative, completely free virtual reality experience designed to improve psychological flexibility and raise awareness of mental health stigma. Based on Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), this program immerses you in eight experiential exercises that will help you discover the automatisms of your behavior and the limits of cognitive control.
